title: ANTDAWGMC's Shenanigans
description: A utility and QoL resource pack to enhance PVP gameplay and make Minecraft even more fun!
body:
# ANTDAWGMC's OFFICIAL RESOURCE PACK!
Ever wanted to see my face everywhere? I don't think so, SO HERE I AM!

**Welcome to ANTDAWGMC'S Shenanigans!** This resource pack includes a bunch of quality of life features along with some clean UI and fancy animations!

CIT Resewn is not needed, but recommended to utilize all the features of the resource pack.


### UPCOMING SOON!
Our team currently are planning on the following for the future updates of this resource pack: Custom sounds, CIT Resewn mod support and easter eggs, and offhand holding!


### Important links!
My YouTube Channel: https://www.youtube.com/@ANTDAWGMC

My Modpack: https://modrinth.com/modpack/grilled-essentials
